purpose: Reusable PMT3 scenario definitions. Each case retains its own semantic input and acceptance; only cases with an observed phase2 execution are measurable baselines.

cases.scenario: Create a complete new requirement and implementation graph, validate it, and render the full graph and documents.

cases.scenario: Supply the same scope and required references to independent investigation workers and include all follow-up reads.
cases.reason: No phase2 investigation context bundle or detailed-read receipts are preserved.

cases.scenario: Keep an unresolved requirement explicit, request clarification, and preserve its acceptance criteria without guessing.
cases.reason: No matching phase2 ambiguous-request execution and clarification history are preserved.
